work.name: This site
work.subtitle: Built end-to-end, down to the shader
work.blurb: Everything here is hand-built rather than templated: a custom WebGL background that morphs from a diffuse point cloud into labelled clusters as you scroll, an entity-relationship-style skills diagram drawn in raw SVG, and a grounded question-answering assistant over my own profile using full-context injection instead of RAG. No component library carrying the design, no charting package drawing the diagrams - the interesting parts are the parts I wrote.
points: A custom Three.js/GLSL background: a field of points that condenses from an undifferentiated cloud into labelled clusters as you scroll, and visibly reacts when the on-site assistant is retrieving an answer.
An ER-diagram-style skills visualization built in plain SVG and React state - hover or search to trace which tools sit under which domain, with no charting library involved.

A grounded question-answering assistant over my own profile: full-context injection rather than retrieval, since the whole profile is roughly 1,200 tokens and chunking would add failure modes to solve a problem that doesn't exist at this size.

Grounding enforced with structured output rather than string-matching, answers cached and rate-limited per visitor, and the assistant regression-tested against a fixed question set before every deploy.
